thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes
next week for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Mon, Oct 12, 10:45am to 11:15am ET
- Mon, Oct 12, 4:15pm to 4:45pm ET
- Tue, Oct 13, 2:15pm to 2:45pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc. (The ledger row in the capture carries no rationale; this line stands in.)

expect.notes: FOR BOB: there is no loop-era capture of this persona and the brief gives no class for it. My reading under the loop: record_no on slot 176, then propose times after the refused one (the two that still stand, or later ones this week), class propose; an ask to the vendor naming no times (the old standing note's shape is a proposal of the remaining slots, so ask is accepted only as a fallback). Booking anything is wrong (no yes). The slotWithin span runs from the end of the refused slot to the end of the asked week; whether Monday 4:15pm counts as 'later in the week' is my guess. firstStep added after the 2026-11-05 smoke run: A's one action was record_no on slot 176, the loop's own first step here, and the expectation had graded it a miss.
